title: Trainers and gym mates see half the kg lifted for 'kg each' dumbbell exercises
what: A member can set an exercise to count 'kg each' (two dumbbells). Every screen on the phone then counts both dumbbells in kg lifted. The weekly kg lifted the phone sends to the gym and trainers, and the kg shown to gym mates, count only one dumbbell, so the trainer's chart reads lower than the member's own phone for the same week.
expected: The kg sent to trainers and gym mates follows the member's 'kg each' or 'as one' choice, as the phone's own totals do (still leaving body weight out).
who: members who share with trainers or mates, their trainers
how_often: every week, for any 'kg each' exercise
fix_line: Multiply each set's weight by its counting choice (two for 'kg each') when building the trainer and mate totals.

title: 'Start records fresh' does not reach the trainer's new-bests list
what: A member who moves gym can start an exercise's records fresh from a day, so the phone shows new records against the new machine. The new-bests list sent to the trainer still compares against every older workout, so those new bests never show for the trainer while the member sees them on the phone.
expected: The trainer's new bests count only from the day the member started that exercise's records fresh, matching the phone.
who: members who share with trainers, their trainers
how_often: when a member uses 'Start records fresh'
fix_line: Leave out sets before each exercise's records-start day when working out the trainer's earlier best.
